ipeds.title: IPEDS via College Navigator (programs and completions, student-to-faculty ratio)

cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs from the Common Data Set G1 for the full 2025-26 year: in-state tuition $6,930, out-of-state and nonresident tuition $18,600, required fees $531. International (F-1/J-1) students pay the nonresident rate. The CDS gives no on-campus food and housing charge; its G5 estimates for commuters not living at home are housing $17,928, food $4,332, transportation $1,188 and other expenses $9,378, with books and supplies $1,500 for all groups (the commuter living-at-home estimate is food $4,332, transportation $1,188 and other $2,005). Per-credit charges: $305 in-state, $620 nonresident. CDS H6 ticks that institutional need-based and non-need-based scholarship and grant aid are both available to degree-seeking nonresidents, but the number of recipients and average award are left blank.

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set 2024-2025 (Fall 2024 entering class): C1 men, women, another-gender and unknown-gender rows add up to 28,111 applied, 13,357 admitted (47.5%) and 2,532 enrolled; the same totals appear in the NCES IPEDS 2025 Data Feedback Report. The CDS residency table gives only the enrolled split (2,354 in-state, 84 out-of-state, 94 international); applicants and admits by residency are blank, so no international admit rate is available. Baruch has no early decision or early action (C21/C22 answered No), is rolling admission, and the waitlist question (C2) is left blank. 296 students (12%) submitted SAT scores; no ACT submit rate or ACT percentiles are reported, and the SAT composite row is blank (only section percentiles are given). The GPA table (C11, all enrolled students, 91.3% reported) lists 4.0 / 3.75-3.99 / 3.50-3.74 / 3.25-3.49 / 3.00-3.24 / 1.0-1.99 = 0.26 / 30.59 / 57.55 / 9.61 / 1.86 / 0.00 percent and 0.13 percent below 1.0 (left out); the 2.50-2.99 and 2.0-2.49 cells are blank. Undergraduate enrollment (16,496) is B1 'Total All Undergraduates' (fall 2024) and the nonresident count (1,031) is the B2 'Total Undergraduates' nonresident cell. Student-to-faculty ratio is CDS I-2 (21 to 1).

cds_test_policy.notes: From the Common Data Set C8: SAT or ACT 'not required for admission, but considered if submitted' (SAT-only and ACT-only rows the same). Baruch's own page states the CUNY SAT/ACT test-optional policy for 'Fall 2023 through Spring 2027 admission'.
